## History

Wace arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) as a youthful, kindly minister alongside his wife during their honeymoon, filled with zeal for their life's labor. Soon after his arrival, [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) prepared a tea party to welcome him and his wife to the village. Wace later served as the new clergyman in the local church.

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--wace.md)

Wace is the wife of the new local clergyman and acts as a gentle, supportive friend to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally ruins a cake meant for the minister's visit, Wace comforts the distraught girl and takes an interest in her flower garden. She also invites [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to tea at the manse, earning Nell's deep admiration through her warmth and kindness.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P5](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0005), +12 more_
